{{Quote|There's a guild mining rep that's been causing some problems for Black Sun. He's moral, upright and won't just do what he's told and take the money. His name's Jinz Finzer. Kill him.|Scolex Grath|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Jinz Finzer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] guild [[Mining/Legends|mining]] representative who operated on the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Scolex Grath]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun criminal syndicate]] ordered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill Finzer for not bending over to the Black Sun's demands.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNobleMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Jinz Finzer]]
Jinz Finzer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
